stops.title: Wo Nhwɛbea
stops.caption: Ɛpono no ano, na deɛ wo dibea ka ho nko ara.
stops.speech: Yei ne Kairos. Ɛbue wɔ wo nhwɛbea so, na biribiara a wohunu ha fa deɛ wodi ho dwuma ankasa ho.

stops.title: Nkyɛnmu no
stops.caption: Akuo nsia. Wohunu deɛ ɛfa wo ho nko ara.
stops.speech: Nkyɛnmu no kyekyɛ mu: Nnipa, Akuo, Nhyiam, Nsɛm Nhwɛmu ne Nhyehyɛeɛ. Afa a wonhunu no, wo dibea nhia no.

stops.title: Asɔrefoɔ
stops.caption: Obiara wɔ nhwɛmu baako mu.
stops.speech: Asɔrefoɔ ne nhwɛmu no. Obiara a ɔwɔ asɔre no mu wɔ ha, ne n’asɔre baa ne sɛ wawie asɔrefoɔ adesua no anaa.

stops.title: Fekuo
stops.caption: Akuo nketewa, a asase mfonini ka ho.
stops.speech: Fekuo ne akuo nketewa no. K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds ne nkaeɛ, a mfonini wɔ hɔ ma wohunu deɛ ɛbɛn wo.

stops.title: Adwumakuo
stops.caption: Asomdwuma akuo ne wɔn nnwuma nhyehyɛeɛ.
stops.speech: Adwumakuo ne asomdwuma akuo no. Biara kora ne mufoɔ, ne nnwuma nhyehyɛeɛ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔka ho so.

stops.title: Mmaeɛ
stops.caption: Ɔsom, nkyerɛwee ne nkrataa.
stops.speech: Mmaeɛ fa ɔsom ne nkyerɛwee ho. Obiara tumi de QR kod kyerɛw ne din, anaa ɛpono ano hɔ kyerɛw no.

stops.title: Akra Kwan
stops.caption: Firi nkitahodie a ɛdi kan kɔsi adwumakuo mu.
stops.speech: Akra kwan di obi a yɛduruu ne ho wɔ asɛmpaka mu akyi: foforɔ, yɛredi akyi, n’ani gye ho, wasakra, na asuafoyɛ.

stops.title: Amanneɛbɔ
stops.caption: Mmaeɛ, nkɔsoɔ ne nkitahodie.
stops.speech: Amanneɛbɔ dane ne nyinaa ma ɛyɛ akontaa. Mmaeɛ nkɔsoɔ, asɔrefoɔ dodoɔ ne nkitahodie, sɛdeɛ wo dibea teɛ.

stops.title: Wo Kasa
stops.caption: Kairos ne saa akwankyerɛ yi, kasa ɛnan mu.
stops.speech: Kairos ka Borɔfo, Frenkye, Krio ne Twi. Sesa no wɔ nkyɛnmu no so, na akwankyerɛ no nso bue wɔ kasa korɔ no ara mu.
